messages:
mason: PTAL — pushed updates to PR #4287: split allocator cleanup into separate commit + added unit tests. Fixed the KV rotation edge-case you flagged. CI is queued. Plan to canary tonight ~6pm PT. Want me to squash or keep split commits for easier revert? @lara @anton

lara: quick skim — thanks for splitting. small nit: log in kv/rotation.go still says "allocator rotate" can we make it "kv: allocator rotate" for grep? also drop trailing whitespace in line 134.

mason: good catch, fixed and pushed in separate commit. diff:
```diff
- log.Infof("allocator rotate")
+ log.Infof("kv: allocator rotate")
```
I also added TestAllocatorRotateEmptyPrefix in allocator_test.go

anton: looks generally good. Q: what's the rollback plan if canary shows perf regression? also what's the intended canary shard size? 5%?

mason: rollback plan: revert the allocator commit only (that's why split). If perf reg, we can revert in <15m and fallback to previous model variant. Planning 5% traffic to start, then 25% after 30m. If no issues, full by 2h. CI link: https://ci.redwood.dev/4287

dev-bot: CI status for PR #4287 — all checks passed :white_check_mark:

lara: PTAL again — added one tiny nil-check suggestion inline, but otherwise LGTM.

mason: pushed nil-check per inline suggestion. PTAL @lara

anton: LGTM. prefer keeping split commits. I'll merge + schedule canary at 17:45 PT unless someone objects.

mason: thanks! I'll hold off on follow-ups until canary starts.

ci-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary for PR #4287 at 18:00 PT. Track at https://deploys.redwood.dev/4287 :rocket:

lara: :shipit:
